# Lab 9.1: BigQuery Studio Notebooks

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a Colab Enterprise notebook in BigQuery Studio, choose a runtime template, and query BigQuery with the `%%bigquery` magic.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the dataset and a small runtime template.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab09
gcloud services enable aiplatform.googleapis.com dataform.googleapis.com compute.googleapis.com
gcloud colab runtime-templates create --region=us-central1 \
  --display-name=lab-small --machine-type=e2-standard-4 --idle-shutdown-timeout=1800s</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Idle shutdown after 30 minutes keeps the cost low.

2. **[Console] Create a notebook.** In Studio click **+ → Notebook → Empty notebook**. At the top right click **Connect → Connect to a runtime → Create new runtime** and pick the `lab-small` template.

3. **[Console] Query with the magic command.** In a code cell:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">%%bigquery df
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS products, ROUND(AVG(retail_price), 2) AS avg_price
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY products DESC</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   In the next cell:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">df.head(10)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Pass a Python variable into SQL.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">params = {"min_price": 100}</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">%%bigquery expensive --params $params
SELECT name, retail_price FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
WHERE retail_price &gt; @min_price ORDER BY retail_price DESC LIMIT 5</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Save it.** Rename the notebook `lab09_intro` and save it. It appears in the **Files** pane next to your saved queries.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Runtime | Created from `lab-small`, shuts down when idle |
| `%%bigquery df` | Query result as a pandas DataFrame |
| Parameters | Passed with `--params` |
| Storage | Notebook stored as a code asset |
